Game Overview

Oink Run is a action game built around speed through a vibrant escape in Oink Run, guiding a daring pig past tricky platforms and enemy threats. Tap effortlessly to jump, unleash a parachute in jeopardy, and navigate this exhilarating chase. Every strategic decision counts in this addictive, high-stakes adventure of timing and reflexes. Can you lead the charge to freedom?
